name: contract-first-paket-bantuan-lapangan
description: | Anggota | Role | Tanggung jawab | |---|---|---| | Dhimas | Contract Owner | Menyusun dan mereview `openapi.yaml` serta `CHANGELOG.md` | | Naya | Service Owner | Menentukan domain, resource, dan aturan bisnis | | Satya | Client Owner | Menganalisis client, idempotency, dan compatibility | | Tama | Integration Owner | Menangani error catalog, mock server, README, dan demonstrasi |
